purpose: User-authorized selectable automatic MT5 strategy, separate from existing strategies; no shadow runner

ordering: All bars closed. Confirm pivot first, then evaluate lifecycle. Breakout requires crossing from previous close. Retest strictly after breakout; confirmation strictly after first retest. Never infer intrabar order.
invalidation: Point 3 breached/touched before entry, any closed low for BUY/high for SELL, or lifecycle expires. Frozen setup ATR defines margins. Confirmed pattern cannot be reused after first directional confirmation even if account/risk/M5 gate rejects it.
context: Existing complete M5 EMA9/21 and slope; require UP for BUY, DOWN for SELL. No new ADX/volume/Fibonacci filter.
confirmation: Close exceeds preceding high/low plus 0.05 frozen ATR, above/below breakout level; directional body and close in favorable 35%.
score: 80 mandatory, +10 favorable RSI50-75 BUY/25-50 SELL, +10 close favorable25%; technical score, not calibrated win probability; threshold at least78.
exits: Point3 structural stop plus existing ATR floor/buffer; opposing confirmed pivot caps common ATR/2R projection. Require structure stops and targets. Shared max stop, net RR, entry drift, spread, sizing, portfolio, cooldown and account checks unchanged. No native trailing/partial/time exit added.
activation: New explicit Setup option; selectable in LIVE_MT5 on linked permitted demo or real account. No automatic migration of saved configuration or auto-start on update.
